note: Current page checked 30 October 2026 displays January 2026 edition. Counting/reporting rules depend on method.

note: January 2011 guidance describes lifecycle validation; product and process context matters.

note: May 2024 manual. Confirm latest FSSAI notifications, product criteria and laboratory scope for regulatory work.

note: Food poisoning can result from preformed toxin; killing bacteria does not necessarily eliminate toxin.

note: Official DOI linked by the Codex Secretariat for the 2023 FAO/WHO publication of CXC 1-1969, incorporating the 2022 revision. Includes good hygiene practices and HACCP.

title: Oxygen Requirements for Microbial Growth
note: Direct support for oxygen requirement categories and catalase reaction principles.

note: Colonization, signs and symptoms, and asymptomatic infection. Educational context; culture results alone do not establish a diagnosis.

title: Virulence Factors of Bacterial and Viral Pathogens
note: Direct support for the molecular distinction between endotoxins and exotoxins; use current FDA guidance for product testing.

title: Catalase Test Protocol
note: Professional society educational protocol; catalase principle, interpretation and controls. Actual testing follows the approved laboratory method.

title: Oxidase Test Protocol
note: Professional society educational protocol; cytochrome c oxidase reaction and interpretation limitations.

title: Coagulase Test Protocol
note: Explains tube clotting and slide clumping formats; a single result is not a full species identification.

note: Laboratory Biosafety Manual fourth-edition monograph, 2020; containment, airflow, equipment selection and safe use.

title: Importance of PCR controls
note: Manufacturer technical guide covering positive, no-template and internal controls, inhibition and extraction failure; not regulatory guidance or an endorsement of a product.

title: About Microbial Ecology
organization: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
